layout: each family lists the upper-triangle entries a_(i,j), i < j, of a skew matrix in row-major order; a row holds the coefficients of t1, ..., tn of that entry form, as [real, imaginary] strings over Q(i) and as residues modulo 32009 (i = 10754); the matrix is the leading form of the Schur numerator of 2i (7 x 7) and the effective form of 2c (6 x 6), each up to the nonzero scalar the record names
